facts.fact: South Sudan's Ministry of ICT and Postal Services announced on 22 November 2024 an aerial survey and base mapping of Juba City and County, to be done in 2025, to produce maps for establishing a Geographic Addressing System, with Juba selected as the pilot area.

systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and Postal Services

SSD.note: The document names an e-government board and unnamed progress but no portal, app or online service.
Nothing stated on local government office connections.

Nothing stated on a taxpayer register; land tax invoicing is only a hoped benefit.
